text: idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇiṃti . kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti . yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti . kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu pabbaji hoti . yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti . evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pabbaji hoti . kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhuno 6 ca apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ
